name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 9 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-06-06, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 3.06 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
